STATUS: ANSWER
The context covers two pipelines, each with its own Sentieon-based setup.
Sarek (Sentieon BWA mem, which is part of a proprietary package): the alignment files are not published by default. Add --save_mapped to save the sorted CRAM and its index under {outdir}/preprocessing/mapped/<sample>/. Add --save_output_as_bam together with --save_mapped to save BAM instead [sarek_output#h013].
raredisease (Sentieon Dedup): alignment files are published as BAM by default. Use --save_all_mapped_as_cram for the full alignment as CRAM, or --save_noalt_mapped_as_cram for the alt-filtered CRAM, which requires --exclude_alt [rare_output#h006].
